notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #8
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[b]NextFest starts tomorrow!
[/b]
We've been working hard to improve our demo with multiple updates, making it more polished and enjoyable. With today's final update, we've now completed the demo in its current form. However, keep in mind that this demo only represents a small portion of our game!

There are still many details we plan to add, and we have already started working on Early Access to bring those ideas to life.

With this final update, we have:
[list]
[*] 
[*] Fixed an issue where time continued to progress during combat dialogue.
[*] Resolved a bug causing the market outline to darken after the market tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue where vehicles would get stuck at city entrances.
[*] Corrected a UI overlap in the pause menu where the ‘Back’ button overlapped with the ‘Add to Wishlist’ button.
[*] Fixed a problem where colors would shift and vehicle headlights wouldn’t turn on after leaving a city.
[*] We hope NextFest goes well for our game and gives us even more motivation for the Early Access phase. Huge thanks to everyone who has supported us so far!
[/list]

Two Nomads

notes.title: Iron Convoy Devlog #02 – Nextfest Preparation
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the second developer diary for Iron Convoy!

In this devlog, we want to share what we have accomplished so far and the steps we plan to take moving forward.

[b]An Important Period Ahead!
[/b]
We have a crucial period coming up as we prepare to showcase our demo during Steam Next Fest. Over the past two weeks, we have reached 500 wishlists, which is an exciting milestone for us! We sincerely thank everyone who has shown interest in our game, played the demo, added it to their wishlist, and shared their feedback.

During this time, we have received a lot of feedback regarding both the demo and the early access version. We have worked hard to address the feedback as quickly as possible and fix any issues. Our goal is to make Iron Convoy even more enjoyable for you, and we will continue improving the game at full speed!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469520/Iron_Convoy_Demo/?curator_clanid=45488512

[b]Steam Next Fest!
[/b]
We released our demo about two weeks ago, and many players have supported us since then. Thank you all for your incredible support!

Yesterday, we released another update for the demo. Before Next Fest begins, we plan to release one final hotfix and update. After that, our focus will shift towards preparing for early access.

[b]Early Access!
[/b]
While we cannot give an exact release date yet, we plan to launch early access shortly after Next Fest. In fact, we have already started preparing for it! As we previously shared in our roadmap, we have a clear vision of the content and features we want to add during this phase.

For the early access release, we aim to fix existing issues, expand gameplay, and introduce the first chapter of the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458157/4e7bd0bb3c5a08dc074c4a69394515dfc66f02b1.png[/img]

[b]What’s Coming in Early Access?
[/b]
Improved Combat System – More diverse enemies, formation changes, new abilities, and a greater focus on tactical battles!

Trade System – Trade will now influence the in-game economy. As you explore cities, you will hear rumors and gather trade tips, helping you make strategic decisions.

Warlords – Powerful enemies will roam certain areas of the map. While these battles will be more challenging, they will also reward you with unique loot that cannot be found elsewhere.

Vehicles & Convoy Customization – New vehicles will be added, allowing you to shape your convoy as you see fit. We will also introduce more customization options for existing vehicles.

New Missions – Additional quests will be introduced, expanding both gameplay and the main story!

We are working tirelessly to make Iron Convoy the best experience it can be. Thank you once again for following and supporting us!

notes.title: Iron Convoy - Hotfix #6
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Wastelanders,[/h1]

We have just released a hotfix addressing several issues reported by the community. Thank you for your feedback and continued support during Demo. Below are the details of the fixes included in this update:

[h2]General Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where the demo would start in Turkish even on English-language devices.
[*]     Resolved an issue where players were sent to buy fuel without sufficient money, yet still completed the quest.
[*]     Investigated and potentially resolved the issue preventing players from crafting car parts using in-game materials. Further testing is ongoing.
[/list]

[h2]Audio Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Fixed incorrect quest completion audio in Rustport, which was playing the Arena quest acceptance sound instead.
[/list]

[h2]Save System[/h2]

[list]
[*]     The game did not have an auto-save system, leading to lost progress when returning to the main menu. While a full auto-save system is under consideration, we have implemented a temporary manual warning panel once you want to return to main menu.
[/list]

Your feedback is invaluable in shaping Iron Convoy. If you encounter any additional issues, please report them through our bug report system. Thank you for being part of this journey!

Stay safe on the road,
Iron Convoy Development Team

notes.title: Iron Convoy Devlog #01 – The Journey Begins
notes.content:
[h1]Iron Convoy Devlog #01 – The Journey Begins[/h1]

Hello everyone, and welcome to the first [b]Iron Convoy[/b] devlog.

As we move toward the [b]Early Access release[/b], we want to keep you updated on the game’s development, upcoming features, and the challenges we are tackling. Since we are a [b]two-person indie team[/b], every step is a significant effort, and we want to bring you along for the ride.

Our goal is to release [b]bi-weekly devlogs[/b] with insights into development, balance changes, and previews of new content.

store.steampowered.com/app/3468670/

[h2]What is our update schedule?[/h2]

We are focusing on [b]major content updates[/b] rather than frequent small patches. [b]Iron Convoy[/b] is a deep strategy and survival game, and each update requires extensive testing and balancing.

However, we will still release [b]smaller updates[/b] for bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements between major updates. This way, we can keep the game stable while also delivering exciting new content in bigger batches.

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]

Right now, we are focusing on [b]bug fixes[/b] and polishing [b]small details[/b] in the story and the map. At the same time, we are planning our [b]Early Access release update[/b] as well as the [b]first bi-weekly update[/b] that will follow shortly after.

Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming next:

✅ [b]Expanded faction system[/b] – Build alliances, make enemies, and shape your place in the wasteland.
✅ [b]More scavenging opportunities[/b] – New salvage points, abandoned outposts, and hidden loot.
✅ [b]Combat refinements[/b] – Improved vehicle abilities, better AI behaviors, and enhanced tactics.
✅ [b]Survival balance changes[/b] – Adjustments to fuel, food, and crew management for a more engaging experience.
✅ [b]Environmental hazards expansion[/b] – More unpredictable events like sandstorms and acid rain that affect your convoy.

This is just the beginning. As we move forward, we will share more details and insights into the world of [b]Iron Convoy[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458157/d9d21110e76ac0ed8cfb576880fce35c5f17f03c.jpg[/img]

[b]Stay Tuned Raiders,[/b]
Oğuz
[b]Iron Convoy Lead Dev.[/b]
